title: Allow TDD with the before-push behavior check
summary: Define the intended result and constraints before writing code or the first test. TDD is allowed. Before pushing, verify the actual outcome and that a skipped action would fail the test.
route: Packaged hook in an external project and README.md

changes.title: Allow TDD and retain review of observable results
changes.problem: The packaged instruction banned TDD and required implementing before adding tests.
changes.decision: Allow TDD after defining the intended result and applicable constraints from the user request. Keep the before-push audit for any coding method.
changes.impact: The same external project receives the new coding instruction alongside the existing before-push and screenshot requirements. The README describes the same policy.
